# The koto floor. /coordinate enters its session through
# skills/coordinate/scripts/coordinate-open.sh and the shared
# scripts/koto-open.sh, the call site for `koto init --vars-file`. The
# template's constrained variables, capture_stdout_as, command gates declared
# overridable: false, deciders and result maps all exist only in koto 0.13.0
# and later, so this `koto init` record, with the flags /deliver and /execute
# declare, is the declared floor: the policy allows no version number here, and
# preflight on an older koto names the missing flags.
# The records catch a koto older than 0.13.0 only. shirabe's koto minimum is
# 0.14.0 (scripts/assert-koto-floor.sh). What 0.14.0 added (a failure terminal
# keeps its session, a child's result is delivered under --no-cleanup, and
# `koto next --to` is refused past a failing non-overridable gate) is behaviour
# with no flag to declare, so a koto that has the entry flags passes preflight
# whatever its version; the README states the minimum and CI tests it.
koto
